gates.summary: Every material item in all seven locked reference snapshots has a disposition.
Canonical normative claims have primary evidence, qualifications, versions, counterexamples, and owners.
Canonical skills, four-client packaging, archives, and clean-clone Codex installation have structural evidence.
A private release holdout with unrelated prompts has not been frozen and scored.
All collection and combined discovery footprints are within the conservative serialized limits.
Zero critical failures is not established across the full quality and holdout matrix.
Post-edit oracle isolation works, but six smokes—including three behavior-rich multi-file cases—saturated across every native arm; discriminatory fixture evidence is not established.

Public routing clears paired thresholds and ours leads every arm in three final batch-offset repetitions, but those are one public case with zero strict ours passes. On the independent lease/fencing transfer, ours exceeded every skill competitor in aggregate but tied baseline, passed zero repetitions, and did not clear paired thresholds. Aggregate behavioral superiority is not established.

Collection-level non-inferiority is not established; ours leads all three final batch-offset repetitions but strictly passes none, ties baseline on the lease/fencing transfer with zero strict passes, and the fintech cell exposed a missing mismatch-rejection finding.

The Engineering review beat baseline on one public cell, but the first Distributed review and the three-repetition lease/fencing transfer tied baseline. No statistically positive paired behavioral improvement is established.

cxuu-golang-skills quality-and-token dominated the fintech review cell; ours used the most input tokens in the first Distributed tie; and baseline quality-and-token dominated ours on the frozen lease/fencing transfer. That transfer dominates four skill competitors and trades off against Gophers, but the behavioral frontier is not established.
Development artifacts are traceable, but the complete release and holdout artifacts do not yet exist.
